author: Matt Wolfe
description:
OpenAI just dropped GPT-5.4... but should you care?

To be totally honest: If you use ChatGPT for brainstorming or basic questions, you probably won’t notice a huge difference. It’s a marginal upgrade for the average user. 

BUT, if you are a coder or power user, this is actually a big deal. It can:
💻 Navigate desktops better and use your mouse/keyboard to perform tasks.
⚡️ Perform coding tasks faster and smarter than 5.3 Codex.
🔎 Perform better web searches.
📂 Go up to a 1 million token context, which is a massive upgrade for API users.

Have you tried it yet? Let me know in the comments.


And for the full breakdown of this and all the biggest AI model releases and news from the past week, go check out my full video linked here.

#openai #ai #chatgpt #ainews
title: Is GPT-5.4 Worth It?
